description: This source file defines an API endpoint class 'CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint' for listing catalog items with pagination in an e-commerce application. It includes route setup, request handling, and data mapping logic.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for retrieving a paged list of catalog items, using dependency injection for URI composition and object mapping.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route '/api/catalog-items' to handle GET requests for catalog item listings with pagination and filters.
